categories.name: مُصْطَلَحَاتٌ قَضَائِيَّةٌ فِي سُورَةِ الْبَقَرَةِ
categories.nameEn: Judicial and Legal Terms in Surah Al-Baqarah

items.verse: وَلَكُمْ فِى ٱلْقِصَاصِ حَيَوٰةٌۭ يَـٰٓأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ
items.verseEn: And there is for you in legal retribution [saving of] life, O you [people] of understanding, that you may become righteous.

items.verse: وَلَا تَأْكُلُوٓا۟ أَمْوَٰلَكُم بَيْنَكُم بِٱلْبَـٰطِلِ وَتُدْلُوا۟ بِهَآ إِلَى ٱلْحُكَّامِ لِتَأْكُلُوا۟ فَرِيقًۭا مِّنْ أَمْوَٰلِ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْإِثْمِ وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
items.verseEn: And do not consume one another's wealth unjustly or send it [in bribery] to the rulers in order that [they might aid] you [to] consume a portion of the wealth of the people in sin, while you know [it is unlawful].

items.verse: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ عُرْضَةًۭ لِّأَيْمَـٰنِكُمْ أَن تَبَرُّوا۟ وَتَتَّقُوا۟ وَتُصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
items.verseEn: And do not make [your oath by] Allāh an excuse against being righteous and fearing Allāh and making peace among people. And Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.

items.verse: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُتَوَفَّوْنَ مِنكُمْ وَيَذَرُونَ أَزْوَٰجًۭا وَصِيَّةًۭ لِّأَزْوَٰجِهِم مَّتَـٰعًا إِلَى ٱلْحَوْلِ غَيْرَ إِخْرَاجٍۢ ۚ فَإِنْ خَرَجْنَ فَلَا جُنَاحَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِى مَا فَعَلْنَ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِنَّ مِن مَّعْرُوفٍۢ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌۭ
items.verseEn: And those who are taken in death among you and leave wives behind - for their wives is a bequest: maintenance for one year without turning [them] out. But if they leave [of their own accord], then there is no blame upon you for what they do with themselves in an acceptable way. And Allāh is Exalted in Might and Wise.

categories.name: عَنَاصِرُ عَذَابِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ فِي سُورَةِ الدُّخَانِ
categories.nameEn: Elements of the Sinners' Punishment in Surah Ad-Dukhan

items.verse: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
items.verseEn: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water."
Like murky oil, it boils within bellies
Like the boiling of scalding water.
[It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,

categories.name: أَلْفَاظٌ مِنْ خِطَابِ إِبْلِيسَ فِي سُورَةِ الْحِجْرِ
categories.nameEn: Words from Iblis's Address in Surah Al-Hijr

items.verse: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
items.verseEn: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."

items.verse: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
items.verseEn: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them [i.e., mankind] on earth, and I will mislead them all
Except, among them, Your chosen servants."

items.verse: إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَـٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ
items.verseEn: Indeed, My servants - no authority will you have over them, except those who follow you of the deviators.

categories.name: مَتَاعُ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا فِي سُورَةِ الزُّخْرُفِ
categories.nameEn: Worldly Luxuries and Provisions in Surah Az-Zukhruf

items.verse: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ
items.verseEn: And they said, "Why was this Qur’ān not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"

items.verse: أَهُمْ يَقْسِمُونَ رَحْمَتَ رَبِّكَ ۚ نَحْنُ قَسَمْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَرَفَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍۢ دَرَجَـٰتٍۢ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًۭا سُخْرِيًّۭا ۗ وَرَحْمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌۭ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ
items.verseEn: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate.
And for their houses - doors and couches [of silver] upon which to recline

items.verse: وَزُخْرُفًۭا ۚ وَإِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَـٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
items.verseEn: And gold ornament. But all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life. And the Hereafter with your Lord is for the righteous.

harf.hint: A four-letter Arabic term meaning intensely eager, impatient, or greedy—the Quran states that humans were 'created' with this quality

deduction.title: The Community That Defied the Day of Rest
deduction.intro: Step into a coastal settlement where a divine command set aside one day for worship and restraint. A group within this community chose to test the limits of that command with a cunning plan, leading to a transformation that would echo through the ages. Who were these souls, and what became of them?
clues: We lived near the coast, where the sea provided our livelihood.
We were commanded to honor one day of the week, setting it aside from worldly pursuits.
On that day, the fish came to us in great numbers, as if tempting us to break the command.
We devised a plan to trap the fish on the eve of the sacred day, then collect them after it passed.
When some among us warned against this deceit, we ignored their counsel and persisted.
For our transgression, we were transformed into apes, despised and rejected.

The staff that became a serpent

deduction.arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعْتَدَوْا۟ مِنكُمْ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَـٰسِـِٔينَ
deduction.verse: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised." (2:65)

translations: the means of access which of them (is) nearest
and they hope (for) His mercy and fear
scramble.hint: A profound verse that reveals even those whom the disbelievers invoke are themselves devotedly seeking nearness to Allah, hoping for His mercy and fearing His punishment.
scramble.arabic: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ يَبْتَغُونَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمُ ٱلْوَسِيلَةَ أَيُّهُمْ أَقْرَبُ وَيَرْجُونَ رَحْمَتَهُۥ وَيَخَافُونَ عَذَابَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ كَانَ مَحْذُورًۭا
scramble.verseEn: Those whom they invoke seek means of access to their Lord, [striving as to] which of them would be nearest, and they hope for His mercy and fear His punishment. Indeed, the punishment of your Lord is ever feared.

root.meaning: This root carries the idea of something falling into place or an event becoming real and unavoidable. Other words built from it describe things that happen, land, or are destined to take place.
